properties.description: The guard against losing a test to the new shape: reads Cargo.toml and every [[test]] program's root, and fails on a file in tests/ declared in no program (it would compile nowhere and run nowhere), a file in two, a declared module with no file, a missing root, and automatic test discovery switched back on. A third test proves the parse read the real programs.
properties.name: every_test_file_runs_in_exactly_one_program.rs
